You can now play the game using either a mouse and keyboard or a controller.
You can also change and customize the controls in the Settings menu.
When an employee is not working, you can now talk to them and ask why they are idle. They will give you a hint explaining why they are not currently working.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45927001/94075db746218f48d3e7dd0a0d6edb367b2a60f6.png"]We have also improved employee movement. Employees should now walk around walls instead of trying to interact with objects through them. They will also choose shorter and more efficient paths whenever possible.
We regularly read your feedback and use it to improve future updates, so please keep sharing your ideas and suggestions. Your input helps us make the game better.

Introduced a new employee type responsible for harvesting mature buds, transporting products to processing stations, delivering items to storage when required, and disposing of empty boxes automatically.
You hire (and fire) the Cultivator the same way as other employees - through the PC.
Added the ability to assign a specific processing machine to each plant. Cultivators will now deliver harvested buds only to the selected machine.
Customers are now able to collect products from display windows placed near the second checkout counter (you reported that the issue that it didn't work well before).
Added an “Invert Look Y” option to the settings menu for inverted mouse movement controls.
We’re continuously reviewing your feedback and using it to shape upcoming updates, so keep sharing your ideas and suggestions - it genuinely helps us make the game better.

Some furniture items can now be filled with weed (for example, the Monster Bong). These items automatically release smoke for a set time, similar to blowing smoke at customers. Nearby customers now have a chance to be attracted into the shop.

notes.title: Here’s a short guide on how it works

items.text: Place it anywhere outside your shop and load it with weed buds. Watch the smoke attract customers.
We also added a new mission about filling the Weed Attractor Furniture with weed.
P.S. You can still blow smoke at customers yourself — that mechanic still works.
When ordering products, you can now see how many you already own, including items on display, on racks, or on the floor.
You can now increase or decrease the quantity of products directly in the cart.
Fixed problems with sorters choosing the wrong boxes and failing to bring them to the warehouse.
We’re still going through all your feedback and using it to plan future updates, so please keep sharing your thoughts - it really helps us improve the game!
Also, a reminder that you can still vote on the features you’d like to see added to our roadmap!

We improved the game's economy - we made the game more balanced, including how players earn EXP, and how they level up. Play the game and let us know if, for example, the EXP gain feels better now.

Also, we added options to change the game's economy settings - you can adjust the difficulty, day length, and how fast you level up. You can set this at the start of a new game or later in your current game using the in-game PC under 'Gameplay Parameters'.
We’ve added the option to sell furniture you no longer need. To do this, go up to the item, interact with it, and pack it up (press E, unless you changed the key in settings).
Then you can sell it (press DEL). Old furniture sells for half the price you paid for it.
Customers move more naturally now. They stay in one place while picking items instead of walking back and forth, and they choose the closest free spot in line
Added sounds for production machines, UV lights, fridges, and plant growth/harvest, plus a new volume slider for these in the game settings
Some office objects are now interactive
Improved ambient sounds around the shop
Better lighting and reflections in the office
We’re still reviewing all your feedback and using it to shape future updates - so please keep sharing it, it helps us a lot!

We’ve added the ability to assign labels to shelves in the warehouse - this will help sorters (or you yourselves) keep things organized more easily. You can see where a given product is and how much of it is left.
Remember: to add a label, go up to the shelf and press E (unless you changed the key in settings).
Better look for categories on the computer
We improved how product categories and subcategories look on PC. Now it’s easier to see which tab is active and to find specific products.
The issue with the numpad has been fixed
(Let us know if it works for you, as the issue only affected certain keyboards.)
Fixed how employees put items back in the warehouse.
They will now first place items on racks that already have the same product.
They will now count items you just bought (if the task is for the same furniture). It will also count even if the furniture is still in the box and not unpacked yet.
We added more sounds to improve the gameplay experience
We’re still going through everything you report and using it to plan future updates - so keep the feedback coming, it really helps us a lot!

Customers are more likely to choose a weed of varying quality

You reported an issue where, after reaching a certain level, customers (including lower-level ones) would stop buying low-quality weed - leaving it sitting on your shelves while customers left the store without purchasing anything. We’ve made a few changes to address this, and customers should now be more willing to buy weed of varying quality. Let us know if the game feels better now!
You also reported issues with sorters often not working properly. We’ve fixed that - they should now perform their duties more reliably 😉.

On the product list screen, you can now see new icons when specific employees are assigned to products. This makes it easier to tell, for example, that a stocker is already handling a given product. We’ve used the same icons as in the employee hiring screen to keep things consistent and easier to recognize.
We’ve also added filtering options - including for products that are being stocked by employees.
Improved explanation of how employees work
We’ve added more information about how stockers and sorters operate - making it easier to understand things like the need to label store shelves so stockers can access them properly.
We’re continuing to closely analyze everything you report, and we’re planning future updates based on that - so please keep the feedback coming, because it’s incredibly valuable!

Ability to pause time when the store is closed

You told us that you feel like the in-game days pass too quickly, so we’re adding an option to pause time when the store is closed. During this time, you can calmly do things like arrange products in the store.
While the store is closed, you’ll see a notification about it on the left side of the screen. You can reopen the store at any time with a single button or by clicking the sign at the entrance.

We’re also adding a box that lets you freely move products between shelves — because we know you want the ability to rearrange them. The universal box is available right away when you approach a shelf with products, by using the right mouse button (unless you've set it differently in the settings).
Fix for sliders in weed upgrades (Low-Level Appeal and High-Level Appeal)
They were swapped before; they now display the correct values.
Saving and loading the store’s open/closed state
We’ve fixed an issue where the store’s open/closed state wasn’t being saved and the store was always closed when loading the game.
Fix for ordering the Green Hookah statue
Fixed an issue where ordering the Green Hookah statue would spawn a Monster Bong statue instead.
Employees no longer pick up weed seeds
After ordering, they remain at the delivery spot so you can move them wherever you want (you don't need to look for them at the warehouse).

We also want to let you know that we’re already looking into the other issues you’ve been reporting (for example, customers not being able to find weed of the quality they’re looking for, or sorters sometimes not working properly). We hope to bring improvements in these areas soon!
